title: Lunar Lander
summary: Atari's Lunar Lander (1979) with the physics kept and the look taken to 2026: an endless chunked moon that remembers your life, pads worth 2×–5× with fuel pads and earned landing tech, a ring accelerator that fires you back up after every landing, and four ways out — the drive-through's door, a derelict relay tower, the horizon ring far above, and the hatch in your own wreck.
